'''Israel Itskovich Brekhman''' (20 November 1921 – 9 July 1994) was a Russian [[pharmacologist]]. He specialized in [[adaptogen]]s, with a focus on [[Ginseng|Panax Ginseng]] and especially [[Siberian ginseng]]. Brekhman was highly awarded by both the [[Soviet Union]] and later by the [[Russia|Russian Federation]] for his research. He was a recipient of [[Order of Lenin]].
